limitations: The result concerns bounded radial self-similar profiles in the range 1<p<m, sigma>0, using the tail manifold established in arXiv:2609.20397v1. It does not classify exceptional profiles with vanishing homogeneous coefficient, compute higher terms after the curvature cancellation, or establish convergence rates for general PDE solutions. Originality is qualified to the best of our knowledge.
provenance: Fresh independent mathematical audit on 2026-10-01 UTC did not validate all required scientific axes; the original research package and prior evidence are preserved.
record_title: A resonance at m = 2p - 1 controls second-order tails in weighted porous-medium self-similarity
